title: Open-source DWG/DXF route boundaries and evidence semantics
mode: Primary project documentation review; plan refinement only
scope: Compare documented route boundaries in ezdxf, GDAL DXF, QCAD dxflib, and LibreDWG
Refine peer/native observation records so strict parse, recovery, projection, preservation, writing, and acceptance cannot collapse into one result
Preserve existing implementation order, reduced local validation cadence, fixture policy, and external-only evidence status

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project documentation
method.limitations: Documentation describes different routes and maturity levels; it is not a reproduced runtime comparison or exhaustive repository survey. Mutable upstream master pages are not release-bound. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.observed: The docs distinguish direct DXF read/write from XREF/import and renderer routes. Direct support covers named ASCII/Binary DXF versions and third-party content retention; the entity exporter ignores unsupported version features rather than converting versions. XREF import has a narrower supported copyable/transformable subset and ignores ACAD_TABLE, unknown raw-only entities/objects, and some document features. Drawing docs disclaim 3D and ACIS rendering.

The driver's known-issues list identifies unsupported entity types, absent 3D/OCS paths for selected entities, heuristic HATCH fill handling, missing MLINESTYLE semantics, and outline-only WIPEOUT handling. This is a projection-specific boundary, not a complete DXF codec claim.

sources.revision: Official dxflib 2.5 documentation and mutable QCAD master module description reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: dxflib sends supported parsed entities/resources through callbacks into consumer-defined code and does not own or retain a complete document model. Useful only for callback-visible fields and a matching version/operation.

sources.revision: Mutable master README/manual/spec and public fuzz-repository metadata reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The README and package spec express different DWG-writer ceilings. The manual describes distinct fuzz input/output modes and an external campaign repository; target existence and mutable maturity prose do not establish executed coverage or semantic correctness.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the optional comparator protocol with exact route/mode provenance, strict-versus-recovery separation, per-source disposition, explicit coverage denominators, and a local-reproduction threshold before adding findings. It does not alter the current implementation queue, fast-slice validation cadence, or fixture admission policy.
